<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<ScrollView xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="@color/dark_background"
    android:clipToPadding="false"
    android:paddingBottom="@dimen/navigation_bar_padding">

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:padding="16dp">

        <!-- Header -->
        <TextView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="@string/calibration_description"
            android:textSize="16sp"
            android:textColor="@color/text_secondary_light"
            android:layout_marginBottom="24dp"
            android:layout_marginTop="12dp"/>

        <!-- PORTRAIT Calibration Card -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/dark_surface"
            app:cardElevation="4dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="12dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/stroke_dark"
            app:strokeWidth="1dp">

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:padding="16dp">

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/calibration_portrait"
                    android:textSize="20sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold"
                    android:textColor="@android:color/white"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/tvPortraitStatus"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="⚠️ Not Calibrated"
                    android:textSize="20sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold"
                    android:textColor="@color/primary_color"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/tvPortraitDate"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="Please calibrate in portrait mode"
                    android:textSize="17sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold"
                    android:lineSpacingExtra="3dp"
                    android:minLines="2"
                    android:textColor="@android:color/white"
                    android:background="@color/background_transparent_80"
                    android:padding="12dp"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="10dp"/>

                <ProgressBar
                    android:id="@+id/pbPortraitProgress"
                    style="?android:attr/progressBarStyleHorizontal"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="8dp"
                    android:max="100"
                    android:progress="0"
                    android:progressTint="@color/primary_color"
                    android:progressBackgroundTint="@color/stroke_dark"
                    android:indeterminate="false"
                    android:visibility="gone"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"/>

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:orientation="horizontal">

                    <Button
                        android:id="@+id/btnCalibratePortrait"
                        android:layout_width="0dp"
                        android:layout_height="48dp"
                        android:layout_weight="1"
                        android:text="Calibrate"
                        android:textSize="14sp"
                        app:cornerRadius="32dp"
                        android:backgroundTint="@color/primary_color"
                        android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"/>

                    <Button
                        android:id="@+id/btnClearPortrait"
                        android:layout_width="0dp"
                        android:layout_height="48dp"
                        android:layout_weight="1"
                        android:text="Clear"
                        android:textSize="14sp"
                        app:cornerRadius="32dp"
                        android:backgroundTint="@color/stop_button_color"
                        android:enabled="false"/>
                </LinearLayout>

            </LinearLayout>

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- LANDSCAPE Calibration Card -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/dark_surface"
            app:cardElevation="4dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="12dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/stroke_dark"
            app:strokeWidth="1dp">

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:padding="16dp">

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/calibration_landscape"
                    android:textSize="20sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold"
                    android:textColor="@android:color/white"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/tvLandscapeStatus"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="⚠️ Not Calibrated"
                    android:textSize="20sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold"
                    android:textColor="@color/primary_color"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/tvLandscapeDate"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="Please calibrate in landscape mode"
                    android:textSize="17sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold"
                    android:lineSpacingExtra="3dp"
                    android:minLines="2"
                    android:textColor="@android:color/white"
                    android:background="@color/background_transparent_80"
                    android:padding="12dp"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="10dp"/>

                <ProgressBar
                    android:id="@+id/pbLandscapeProgress"
                    style="?android:attr/progressBarStyleHorizontal"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="8dp"
                    android:max="100"
                    android:progress="0"
                    android:progressTint="@color/primary_color"
                    android:progressBackgroundTint="@color/stroke_dark"
                    android:indeterminate="false"
                    android:visibility="gone"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"/>

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:orientation="horizontal">

                    <Button
                        android:id="@+id/btnCalibrateLandscape"
                        android:layout_width="0dp"
                        android:layout_height="48dp"
                        android:layout_weight="1"
                        android:text="Calibrate"
                        app:cornerRadius="32dp"
                        android:textSize="14sp"
                        android:backgroundTint="@color/primary_color"
                        android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"/>

                    <Button
                        android:id="@+id/btnClearLandscape"
                        android:layout_width="0dp"
                        android:layout_height="48dp"
                        android:layout_weight="1"
                        android:text="Clear"
                        app:cornerRadius="32dp"
                        android:textSize="14sp"
                        android:backgroundTint="@color/stop_button_color"
                        android:enabled="false"/>
                </LinearLayout>

            </LinearLayout>

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Instructions Card -->
        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/dark_surface"
            app:cardElevation="4dp"
            app:cardCornerRadius="12dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/stroke_dark"
            app:strokeWidth="1dp">

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:padding="16dp">

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/calibration_instructions_title"
                    android:textSize="18sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold"
                    android:textColor="@android:color/white"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"/>

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/calibration_step1"
                    android:textSize="14sp"
                    android:textColor="@android:color/white"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/calibration_step2"
                    android:textSize="14sp"
                    android:textColor="@android:color/white"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/calibration_step3"
                    android:textSize="14sp"
                    android:textColor="@android:color/white"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/calibration_step4"
                    android:textSize="14sp"
                    android:textColor="@android:color/white"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/calibration_step5"
                    android:textSize="14sp"
                    android:textColor="@android:color/white"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"/>

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/calibration_warning"
                    android:textSize="14sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold"
                    android:textColor="@color/primary_color"/>

            </LinearLayout>

        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <!-- Action Buttons Container -->
        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="horizontal"
            android:layout_marginTop="8dp">

            <!-- Cancel Button -->
            <Button
                android:id="@+id/btnCancel"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="56dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:text="@string/calibration_btn_cancel"
                android:textSize="16sp"
                app:cornerRadius="32dp"
                android:backgroundTint="@android:color/holo_red_dark"
                android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"/>

            <!-- Continue Button -->
            <Button
                android:id="@+id/btnContinue"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="56dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:text="@string/calibration_btn_continue"
                android:textSize="16sp"
                app:cornerRadius="32dp"
                android:backgroundTint="@color/primary_color"
                android:enabled="false"/>

        </LinearLayout>

        <!-- Clear All Button (only for settings) -->
        <Button
            android:id="@+id/btnClearAll"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            android:text="@string/calibration_btn_clear_all"
            android:textSize="16sp"
            app:cornerRadius="32dp"
            android:backgroundTint="@android:color/holo_red_dark"
            android:enabled="false"
            android:visibility="gone"/>

    </LinearLayout>

</ScrollView>
